mentions.name: odap
mentions.description: A reference site documenting anti-patterns in online discourse — unproductive expressions in replies that hinder pleasant, productive, and focused discussion, distinct from logical fallacies. Aimed as a guide to help improve the quality of internet discussion; currently a rough work in progress.
mentions.problem: Online discussions contain unproductive expressions that aren't conducive to pleasant, productive, and focused discourse.
mentions.source_excerpt: Started working on a site to document anti patterns in online discourse. Not quite logical fallacies but more so unproductive expressions that aren’t conducive to pleasant, productive, and focused discussion.
